notes.title: Halloween is Here
notes.notes:
Once a year we Celebrate the Halloqueen.
From 16 October to 15 November Halloween Map and quests will be enabled.

Start the event in Cityhall, talking William in Normal->Seasonal Quests
Find the portal to her Dungeon  slaying 50 Zombies to grant yourself access.

Once on the map, Talk to the Halloqueen to get the MAIN Quest to follow.
